name: Koshimizu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Koshimizu town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing the character 清.
history: Municipal flag of Koshimizu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1953.

features.role: Koshimizu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing the character 清
